fee_notes: Standard fee $49,500; 10% multi-unit discount to $44,550; veteran discount: $44,550 first Center or $40,095 subsequent Center. REAFC Fee additional $15,500-$44,500 depending on conversion/ownership status. Pre-opening tech fee $250/month; microsite setup $700 one-time.
raw_excerpt: You pay us a $49,500 initial franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee is uniformly imposed except for the following discounts: (a) Multi-Unit Discount: ... $44,550 initial franchise fee. (b) Veteran Discount: ... (i) a $44,550 initial franchise fee if you are purchasing your first franchised Center or (ii) a $40,095 initial franchise fee if you are an existing DOGTOPIA® franchisee purchasing an additional Center.
